newsitem.title: USA: Southern and BOMAC in home equity alliance.
newsitem.headline: Southern and BOMAC in home equity alliance.

text.p: Southern Pacific Funding Corp and Texas-based BOMAC Capital Mortgage Inc said Wednesday they have signed a letter of intent to form a strategic alliance providing up to $600 million of non-conforming home equity loans.
BOMAC will provide the loans for 36 months or $600 million, whichever occurs first, and Southern Pacific will finance 100 percent of the loans BOMAC originates, the companies said.
The companies said the alliance "is the first of what should be a series of similarly structured relationships."
